title: Pointwise diagonal cohomological vanishing implies completeness of the Postnikov tower

standard_prerequisites.name: Derived inverse limits and Milnor sequence
standard_prerequisites.statement: RΓ(U,-) commutes with derived countable inverse limits; its cohomology lies in the short exact sequence with lim and R^1lim. Eventually constant inverse systems have R^1lim=0.

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard truncation triangles and sheafification
standard_prerequisites.statement: Canonical truncations fit in the cohomology-object triangle, and H^m(K) is the sheaf associated to U↦H^m(U,K).

core_obligations: Construct a point-dependent truncation threshold controlling all three cohomology degrees in the truncation triangle and obtain simultaneous stabilization of H^(m-1) and H^m on a neighborhood basis.
Prove the stalkwise derived-limit injection from the Milnor sequence and shrinking of representatives, then combine it with the fixed truncation isomorphism to recover the original complex.

difficulty_reason: The essential point is a locally uniform three-degree truncation bound and a stalkwise inverse-limit argument. It does not follow merely from degreewise stabilization of cohomology sheaves, since products and stalks need not commute.
